clause: Text-edit history binding + type measurement law [STU-TYP-050,STU-TYP-051]

scope.summary: Bind every editing operation on a StudioTextStory (character/paragraph attribute change, style bind, glyph insert, reflow, thread edit) to emit a StudioHistoryEntry so type edits participate in the per-file undo/history surface (14.19) identically to raster/vector — text edits are NOT a separate undo silo. Enforce the type measurement law: type sizes, leading, baseline shift, and tab positions are carried in points per [STU-DOC-003]; Figma density-independent-pixel inputs and CSS-style percentages are accepted at the API decode step and converted to the typed unit there, never stored as a mixed-unit field.
acceptance_criteria: all text edits emit StudioHistoryEntry (shared undo); points-only storage; decode-step unit conversion
expected_tests: live: char attr change + style bind + glyph insert + reflow each append a StudioHistoryEntry and are undoable/replayable per-file
test: dip/percent size inputs converted to points at decode; no mixed-unit stored field

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Type edits become an undo silo; mixed-unit storage corrupts promotion-equivalence.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
